API_KEY.description: Generated API authentication key, or a reference to the shared internal API key. Keep private and preserve matching references.

HF_HOME.description: Hf home for marker. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

XDG_CACHE_HOME.description: Xdg cache home for marker. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

TORCH_DEVICE.description: Torch device for marker. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH.description: Repository-relative Dockerfile used to build this service. Keep the supplied path.

UPSTREAM_HOST.description: Upstream host resolved automatically from the linked service. Keep this reference when using the included topology.

UPSTREAM_PORT.description: Upstream port for marker-api. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

ACCESS_USER.description: Access user for marker-api. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

ACCESS_PASSWORD.description: Generated access password. Keep private and preserve with backups.

PORT.description: HTTP port inside this service. Keep the default to match its Railway public port and health check.

RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH.description: Repository-relative Dockerfile used to build this service. Keep the supplied path.
